
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22454219" title="发布于 2026-08-13 19:51">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于AScript的Lua脚本语言发布啦</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持扩展多种脚本语言，2026年8月12日正式发布了lua脚本语言AScript.Lang.Lua，快来试试吧！</p>
<h2 id="h_2070977094071460936_0" data-into-catalog-status="">一、介绍</h2>
<p data-pid="IJbqYRXC">支持 Lua 基础语法和数据类型，以及表、元表、面向对象、模块等功能。</p>
<h2 id="h_2070977094071460936_1" data-into-catalog-status="">二、安装</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package AScript
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-package AScript.Lang.Lua</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2070977094071460936_2" data-into-catalog-status="">三、使用说明</h2>
<ul>
<li data-pid="kuI_jS-J">命名空间：using AScript.Lang.Lua;</li>
<li data-pid="RX98fmCM">常用数据类型：</li>
<ul>
<li data-pid="bQx0sCoJ"><code>nil</code>: 空值</li>
<li data-pid="y1pO8RzE"><code>boolean</code>:&nbsp;布尔值&nbsp;(<code>true</code>,&nbsp;<code>false</code>)</li>
<li data-pid="tPDKUMYi"><code>number</code>: 数值 (整数和浮点数)</li>
<li data-pid="BYea8i9h"><code>string</code>: 字符串</li>
<li data-pid="9Ow4sj3-"><code>table</code>: 表 (数组)</li>
</ul>
<li data-pid="nUYSpTZ9">运算符</li>
<ul>
<li data-pid="oDRZNsLw">算术运算符:&nbsp;<code>+</code>,&nbsp;<code>-</code>,&nbsp;<code>*</code>,&nbsp;<code>/</code>,&nbsp;<code>%</code>,&nbsp;<code>^</code>&nbsp;(幂),&nbsp;<code>//</code>&nbsp;(整数除法)</li>
<li data-pid="MX6QQTx_">关系运算符:&nbsp;<code>&lt;</code>,&nbsp;<code>&gt;</code>,&nbsp;<code>&lt;=</code>,&nbsp;<code>&gt;=</code>,&nbsp;<code>==</code>,&nbsp;<code>~=</code></li>
<li data-pid="BpvxAq1s">逻辑运算符:&nbsp;<code>and</code>,&nbsp;<code>or</code>,&nbsp;<code>not</code></li>
<li data-pid="6iJiafps">连接运算符:&nbsp;<code>..</code>&nbsp;(字符串连接),&nbsp;<code>#</code>&nbsp;(长度)</li>
<li data-pid="nhbxSCnj">赋值运算符:&nbsp;<code>=</code>,&nbsp;<code>+=</code>,&nbsp;<code>-=</code>,&nbsp;<code>*=</code>,&nbsp;<code>/=</code>,&nbsp;<code>%=</code>,&nbsp;<code>^=</code>,&nbsp;<code>..=</code></li>
</ul>
<li data-pid="DT8iRclw">控制结构</li>
<ul>
<li data-pid="lEfH6SJ_">条件语句:&nbsp;<code>if ... then ... elseif ... then ... else ... end</code></li>
<li data-pid="kvjq7xyk">while循环:&nbsp;<code>while ... do ... end</code></li>
<li data-pid="VFBC-F26">repeat循环：<code>repeat ... until ...</code></li>
<li data-pid="lxvYANt3">数值for循环:&nbsp;<code>for i = start, end, step do ... end</code></li>
<li data-pid="3uzubN0x">泛型for循环:&nbsp;<code>for v in expr do ... end</code></li>
<li data-pid="MMdgwI1-">泛型for循环:&nbsp;<code>for i,v in expr do ... end</code></li>
</ul>
<li data-pid="QxosF0nE">函数定义:&nbsp;<code>function name(args) ... end</code></li>
<li data-pid="jOBh4L2g">匿名函数：<code>local f = function(args) ... end</code></li>
<li data-pid="R4uKpa4k">局部变量:&nbsp;<code>local var = value</code></li>
<li data-pid="QZsV3QoK">表构造器</li>
<ul>
<li data-pid="JYCUxgtK">数组风格:&nbsp;<code>{ value1, value2, value3 }</code></li>
<li data-pid="Sp4wUcgl">字典风格:&nbsp;<code>{ key1 = value1, key2 = value2 }</code></li>
<li data-pid="mL4PeDdi">混合风格:&nbsp;<code>{ 1, 2, name = "test" }</code></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_3" data-into-catalog-status="">1、注册语言</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> Script.Langs.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, LuaLang.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可全局设置为默认语言
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Script.Langs.Set("lua", LuaLang.Instance, setDefault: true);</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_4" data-into-catalog-status="">2、字符串连接</h3>
<p data-pid="5dQiSebj">两个字符串连接使用<code>..</code>操作符而不是<code>+</code>操作符。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'hello'..123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_5" data-into-catalog-status="">3、数据打包/解包</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打包</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local format='&lt;i4i4fc10'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local hp=12500
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local mp=8700
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local atk=156.5
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local name='john'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local data = string.pack(format, hp, mp, atk, name)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">print(#data) -- 控制台输出data长度
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解包</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local a,b,c,d=string.unpack(format, data)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12500</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8700</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">156.5</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">john</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">d</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_6" data-into-catalog-status="">4、条件语句</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local x = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">if x &gt;= 10 and x &lt; 50 then
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    local a = 5
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    local b = 15
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    x = a + b + 80
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">elseif x &gt;= 50 and x &lt; 100 then
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    x = 200
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">else
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    x = 300
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_7" data-into-catalog-status="">5、while循环</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local i = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local sum = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">while i &lt; 5 do
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    i = i + 1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    sum = sum + i
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_8" data-into-catalog-status="">6、数值for循环</h3>
<ul>
<li data-pid="8H479oYL">语法：<code>for i=start,end[,step] do ... end</code>，其中step默认为1</li>
<li data-pid="xabMyHJd">注：循环体内部改变循环变量i的值，不影响循环次数</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local sum = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for i = 1, 5 do
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    i = i + 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    sum = sum + i
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">65L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_9" data-into-catalog-status="">7、泛型for循环</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local sum = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- for v in ipairs({1, 2, 3, 4, 5}) do
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for i, v in ipairs({1, 2, 3, 4, 5}) do
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    sum = sum + v
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_10" data-into-catalog-status="">8、函数</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function factorial(n)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    if n &lt;= 1 then
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">        return 1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return n * factorial(n - 1)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">factorial(5)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_11" data-into-catalog-status="">9、表（数组）</h3>

<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_14" data-into-catalog-status="">12、面向对象(OOP)</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 定义动物类（Animal）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Animal = {name = 'Unknown'}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- Animal 类的构造函数
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function Animal:new(name)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  local o = {}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  setmetatable(o, self)  -- 设置元表，使其继承 Animal 的方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  self.__index = self  -- 让对象可以访问 Animal 的方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  o.name = name or 'Unknown'  -- 设置名称，默认为 'Unknown'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  return o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- Animal 类的方法：叫声
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function Animal:speak()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  return self.name .. ' makes a sound.'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 定义狗类（Dog），继承自 Animal
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Dog = Animal:new()  -- Dog 继承 Animal 类
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 重写狗类的构造函数
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function Dog:new(name, breed)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  local o = {}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  setmetatable(o, self)  -- 设置元表，使其继承 Dog 和 Animal 的方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  self.__index = self  -- 让对象可以访问 Dog 的方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  o.name = name or 'Unknown'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  o.breed = breed or 'Unknown'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  return o
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 重写狗类的叫声方法（重写 Animal 的 speak 方法）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function Dog:speak()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  return self.name .. ' barks.'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 创建 Animal 对象
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local animal = Animal:new('Generic Animal')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local s1 = animal:speak()  -- 输出 'Generic Animal makes a sound.'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">41</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- 创建 Dog 对象
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local dog = Dog:new('Buddy', 'Golden Retriever')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local s2 = dog:speak()  -- 输出 'Buddy barks.'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">s1 .. ';' .. s2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Generic Animal makes a sound.;Buddy barks.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_15" data-into-catalog-status="">13、模块</h3>
<p data-pid="BRtpsQFf">使用<code>require</code>引入模块，优先查找<code>IScriptModule</code>模块，再查找模块目录中的模块文件。</p>
<p data-pid="lBCtVUM2">1）添加模块目录</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> LuaLang.Instance.Modules.AddDir(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./lua/modules</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>2）模块目录中添加<code>Person.lua</code>文件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> Person = {name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span>, age = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Person:new(name, age)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">local</span> obj = {}  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建一个新的表作为对象</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">setmetatable</span>(obj, self)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置元表，使其成为 Person 的实例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     self.__index = self  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置索引元方法，指向 Person</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     obj.name =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     obj.age =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> obj
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">end</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Person:introduce()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">My name is </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> .. self.name .. <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> and I am </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> .. self.age .. <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> years old.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">end</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Person</pre>
</div>
<p>3）引入并使用模块</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">require 'Person'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local person1 = Person:new('Alice', 30)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">person1:introduce()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">My name is Alice and I am 30 years old.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>

<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_16" data-into-catalog-status="">14、io模块</h3>
<p data-pid="TikIrhXT">文件操作，服务端请谨慎使用，避免脚本恶意修改、删除文件。</p>
<p data-pid="klsiFO_D">1）安装模块</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-package AScript.Lang.Lua.io</pre>
</div>
<p>2）注册io模块</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> LuaLang.Instance.Modules.Add(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">io</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AScript.Lang.Lua.io.LuaIOModule());</pre>
</div>
<p>3）使用io</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">require 'io'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local f = io.open(file, 'w')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f:write('hello')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f:close()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local f = io.open(file, 'r')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local content = f:read()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f:close()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./test.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>

<h2 id="h_2070977094071460936_17" data-into-catalog-status="">四、与宿主程序交互</h2>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_18" data-into-catalog-status="">1、脚本调用C#函数</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local a = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local b = 20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(a, b)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注入函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (x, y) =&gt; x +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2070977094071460936_19" data-into-catalog-status="">2、C#调用脚本中的函数</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function sum(x,y)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return x+y
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local a = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">local b = 20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(a, b)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lua</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30L</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, script.Eval(code));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取脚本中的函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sum = script.Context.GetFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80L</span>, sum(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2070977094071460936_20" data-into-catalog-status="">五、结束语</h2>
